Receiver is at v2 (epoch 28), still admitted on WARD-A. Doing nothing: the receiver keeps showing WARD-A, so the bed board, pharmacy and the EPR stay out of date (inferred). Afterwards Shutter can verify only the receipt and the receiver's history (WIC-5). Effects on downstream consumers can only be inferred (DEP-1.1).
